deviations.authority: P5-T1 Q1b N1 ruling (docs/plans/phase5-dev/phase5-tasks.md P5-T12 条 仲裁增补)
deviations.statement: The vendored texts teach a `failed` terminal task state (team-mode.ts:108 "Every task is in a terminal state: `completed` or `failed`"; team.md:2 the re-check-after-completes-or-fails clause) that the vendored team-core tasklist schema does NOT contain — TEAM_TASK_STATUSES here is ['pending','claimed','in_progress','completed','deleted'] (omo-team/src/tools/team-task.ts:76, anchored to the vendored team-core tasklist). `status:"failed"` is therefore a HOLLOW instruction on this execution surface: a model following the text verbatim would get `unknown task status 'failed'` from the tool. Bodies kept byte-verbatim (vendor 正文逐字不动); the adaptation authority is the vendored tasklist schema, and the tool's refusal message names the legal enum.

deviations.authority: P5-T1 Q1b N9 ruling (same task-book entry)
deviations.statement: Name drift across the two vendored texts AND away from DSH: team.md:2 names `delegate_task` (underscore), team-mode.ts:90 and :160 name `delegate-task` (hyphen) — NEITHER name exists on the DSH tool surface, where delegation is the roster's ten delegation toolNames (omo-agents/src/roster.ts; the same drift already recorded for the vendored shared-skills in the Phase 4 notices). The team.md prohibition ('NEVER substitute with delegate_task — it is not equivalent') still holds its semantics: it forbids substituting ordinary delegation for team orchestration, whichever name the local surface uses.

deviations.authority: P5-T12 任务书 交付物 4（Q-4 NOTES-6 联动）
deviations.statement: CONSISTENCY VERIFIED — the OMO-family team_* calls the vendored shared-skills teach match this repo's vendored+ported tool face, so NO rewrite is needed on those skill texts. Measured: refactor/SKILL.md teaches `team_send_message(teamRunId=<id>, to="lead", summary=…, body=…)` (L672, L703, L729), `team_send_message(to="*")` broadcast, `team_task_create(teamRunId, subject, description, blockedBy)` (L709) and `team_task_update(status=completed|pending)` (L672, L678, L729); debugging/02-investigate.md teaches `team_send_message` / `team_task_create` by name (L58, L79). This repo's surface: team_send_message accepts teamRunId(min 1)/to(min 1)/body(string)/kind/correlationId/summary?/references? with to='*' = lead broadcast ('broadcast requires lead role' verbatim refusal, omo-team/src/tools/team-message.ts:100,338-340); team_task_create takes teamRunId/subject/description/blockedBy? (team-task.ts:167-190); team_task_update takes the five-value status incl. completed and pending (team-task.ts:76,265-277). NO vendored shared-skill teaches `team_task_update(status=failed)` (the only `status: "failed"` hit under vendor/shared-skills is 08-qa.md:54, about READING a response sub-field, not a tool parameter). The remaining texts-vs-surface contradictions stay the two already-registered notes above (N1 terminal-status, N9 delegation-name drift); neither occurs in the shared-skills team_* call sites.

deviations.authority: P5-T13 仲裁增补（T12 评审登记 2026-10-12：deviations[] 登记优先于 NOTICE-only，opencode 评审登记）
deviations.statement: ADAPTATION REGISTERED at the consuming side — the team.md:2 fallback sentence 'If the team_* tools are absent, team_mode is disabled — tell the user to set team_mode.enabled=true and restart opencode' is an opencode-carrier instruction: DSH has NO team_mode.enabled configuration key, no such config file and no restart ritual behind it, so following the sentence literally sends the user at a dead switch (worse than silence: it implies the fix exists). The vendored body stays VERBATIM (byte-faithful, sha-pinned above). The adaptation lives in the consuming texts: (a) the keyword-injected team.md arrives verbatim in sessions where the upgraded commands instruct team-mode, and BOTH upgraded bodies answer the sentence in place — the hyperplan full-guidance item 7 and the remove-ai-slops addendum MUST-NOT last line each state 'there is no configuration switch in this deployment; the live team_* tool surface IS the switch' — neither body names the flag; (b) the degraded hyperplan guidance already refuses every config path, and the degraded remove-ai-slops flow needs no switch at all. The sentence's SEMANTICS survive adapted (absent tools = the degraded flow runs, said out loud); only the dead instruction target is replaced.
deviations.resolution: registered in deviations[] + consumer-side adaptation notes; body verbatim
